messages:
support-bot: New ticket CS-4578 from Acme Corp: streaming chat + function-calls + structured-output failing under load. https://ourtracker/CS-4578

maya (Support): Adding context: customer uses long-running sessions with streaming enabled and fn_call to orchestrate tools. They see duplicate/missing function call boundaries and occasional abrupt stream end -> fallback to non-streaming sometimes returns raw text instead of schema. Reported SLA breach. Customer wants prioritization.

alex (PM): @maya thanks. Quick questions: (1) do they require streaming + fncall + structured output together or is structured output optional? (2) expected acceptance criteria for GA? :thinking:

maya (Support): They must have structured output (JSON schema) for downstream ingestion. Streaming is preferred for UX but can accept short non-streaming fallback if schema preserved. Key ask: deterministic schema + clear partial-stream markers so orchestrator can apply functions incrementally.

jordan (Eng): :eyes: Reproduced locally with their repro. Root causes look like: a) our streaming partial frames currently emit text tokens before we emit function_call object; b) fallback path that switches to non-streaming currently serializes final text not the structured parse. Need two PRs: streaming -> stream structured frames; fallback -> preserve structured payload.

sachin (Sales): Customer is high-revenue, wants this fixed in next quarter. Will escalate for dedicated capacity pilot if delayed.

alex (PM): Proposed scope for intake: 1) Spec: streaming frame contract for function calls + schema-bound frames. 2) Backwards-compatible fallback behavior. 3) Test harness & canary w/ Acme. Launch criteria: unit/integration tests + perf delta <10% p50 latency. Thoughts?

jordan (Eng): Agree. Implementation notes: we'd add new frame type `fn_call_chunk` that carries JSON chunks and an `eof` frame. Minimal API surface: new param `structured_streaming=true` and `fn_call_policy=stream|final`. Example client behavior below:

```
POST /v1/chat/stream
{
  "model":"redwood-chat-2",
  "stream": true,
  "structured_streaming": true,
  "fn_call_policy": "stream"
}
-- stream frames --
{"type":"start_fn_call","name":"open_file","args":{}}
{"type":"fn_call_chunk","chunk":"{\"path\":\"/tmp/...\"}"}
{"type":"fn_call_chunk","chunk":"\"mode\":\"r\"}"}
{"type":"end_fn_call"}
{"type":"eof"}
```

maya (Support): Customer confirmed they can run canary. Ask: can we expose per-session concurrency limit? they want to avoid interleaving across sessions. Also need SDK-level helpers.

lisa (SRE): Per-session concurrency should be doable with tokens/session mapping. Need to quantify RU change. I'll run a capacity model.

alex (PM): OK. I'll open a formal PRD w/ acceptance criteria and add ticket to roadmap board. Priority: P1 for next sprint planning? Vote: :+1: for P1 from jordan, maya; sachin wants P0.

sachin (Sales): :thumbsup: will push timeline with Acme.

support-bot: Linked to epic EP-3245. Will post PRD link once created. Closing thread for triage notes.
